stopping_rules.rule: Do not launch until explicit exact-prefix approval, actual current official checkpoint success and a separately frozen complete native/proof/analysis contract. This draft is not launch-ready.
Full census requires all 6384 cells per arm, including identity. A 600-second stage or 3600-second iteration stop preserves failed/incomplete coverage; it never becomes a smaller successful census.
A wrong row/source/branch, failed A/A replay or missed planted relation invalidates the instrument; preserve exact source/log/payload and amend before rerun.

invalidation_rules: Any row, source, column, branch or witness defect invalidates coverage.
Incomplete/timeout coverage is reported; no favorable subset or silent whole-scope substitution.
Scientific/proof launch without actual approved official checkpoint is forbidden.
Independent reference may not seed candidate root finding, stopping, setup logs or target scalar.

decision_rule.text: A finite coverage pass requires every declared cell complete with zero row/source/branch defects, all A/A rows equal and all meaningful semantic controls rejecting altered payloads without receipt. Otherwise invalid_instrument or incomplete_coverage, never a yield or speed result.
decision_rule.threshold: Every required cell and control passes its exact predicate. No statistical test.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell exact missing/extra ordered signed rows, complete case membership and branch inclusion; no averaging away a defect.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact defect counts per cell; actual polynomial degrees and unpriced request vectors separately.
